title: A squarefree polynomial divides a power only when it divides its base
statement: Let $E$ be a field [def-weil-field], let $E[T]$ be its polynomial ring [def-weil-polynomial-ring], and let $Q,g\in E[T]$. Suppose $Q$ is squarefree in the explicit sense that for every $H\in E[T]$, if $H^2$ divides $Q$ then $H$ is a unit of $E[T]$. For every integer $m\ge1$, if $Q$ divides $g^m$, then $Q$ divides $g$.
